summary: Exact candidate d8a3b79 restores controlled single-rank scheduler overlap and removes the whole-call native loader lock, but it does not safely parallelize real native Transformers/Diffusers construction. An independent adversarial probe through _load_native_with_context reproduced a process-global torch default-dtype race: requested float16/float64 contexts observed float64/float32 and left the process default at float16 instead of float32. The candidate regression replaces load_native with a sleep, so it cannot detect this real native-library behavior. The original issue is only partially addressed and its real-model performance, wake/refit, pinned checkpoint memory, distributed, and peak-memory requirements remain unresolved or unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Original sequential behavior reproduced: max_active=1, elapsed_seconds=0.4020 for two 0.20-second component loads.
Controlled mocked native calls overlapped: max_active_native_loads=2, elapsed_seconds=0.2008.

Adversarial native construction race using Transformers' actual local_torch_dtype context: component a requested float16 but observed float64, component b requested float64 but observed float32, and global default ended float16 rather than original float32.
Candidate regression and nearby loader suite: 32 passed.
Extended compatibility: 68 passed and 9 subtests passed.
Synthetic GPU scheduler numerical test passed against NumPy; this does not validate a real Qwen-Image/native model load.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2. Synthetic candidate GPU test passed against NumPy. No Qwen-Image weights were available.

remaining_counterexamples: Parallel native Transformers/Diffusers construction is not thread-safe: third-party contexts mutate process-global torch default dtype and module-registration hooks outside SGLang's narrower model_construction_lock.
The reported Qwen-Image 63.20-second module-load bottleneck and launch-time reduction remain unmeasured with real weights.
Sleep/wake restoration and post-training refit paths are unchanged and untested.
Production checkpoint mappings remain pageable; pinned checkpoint loading is not implemented or validated.
Multi-rank component loading remains sequential by design.
Peak host memory and storage pressure are neither automatically bounded nor measured with representative checkpoints.
remaining_limitations: No Qwen-Image or representative Transformers/Diffusers model weights were available.
The available GPU qualified only the synthetic numerical scheduler test, not model architecture semantics or launch performance.

No native C/C++/CUDA/HIP source changed between base and candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable. Imports resolved to /job/repo/python for SGLang and the pinned /opt/venv packages for torch, transformers, and diffusers.
